purpose: The program's product: the bridge between anatomy and charges. PROVEN cells and MEASURED cells are MECHANICALLY DISTINGUISHED -- a theorem and a regression are not the same kind of object, and a table that blurs them is the thing this program exists not to produce.

status_vocabulary.PROVEN-NETTED: a pinned theorem (Bridge Ledger, I3-verified). Not testable; a known-answer calibration cell.
status_vocabulary.PROVEN-ISLAND: proven on a restricted class; only off-island extrapolation is testable.
status_vocabulary.UNPINNABLE: no single theorem statement carries the claim as stated. Legal terminal status.
status_vocabulary.MEASURED: this program's own out-of-sample result. Never upgraded to PROVEN by any accuracy.
